_doc.what: Per-character authored ground shadows (FB-23). Keyed by character kind id: 'pip' (the player) or an NPC sprite id (e.g. 'wren'). Written by the character shadow editor (?editor=character&kind=<id>); read by GameScene via getCharacterShadow(). A kind with no entry keeps the FB-21 feet-ellipse default — migrate one kind at a time.

shadow.dx: shape CENTRE x offset from the sprite CENTRE, px
shadow.dy: shape CENTRE y offset from the sprite CENTRE, px (positive = down, toward the feet)
